items.title: Winklevoss PAC moves into Texas Senate race with $81K ad buy
items.summary: While crypto-aligned PACs have stepped up spending in Ohio, a committee launched by the co-founders of crypto exchange Gemini made one of its first forays into the Lone Star State.

items.title: Underdog taps zerohash to bring crypto deposits to prediction markets
items.summary: The new funding option, expected to launch later this year, will allow eligible Underdog users to deposit digital assets around the clock.

items.title: Bitcoin hashrate hits seven-month high as AI shift fails to ease mining competition
items.summary: According to BlocksBridge, Bitcoin's mining difficulty is rising despite the industry's AI transition, with smaller operators potentially absorbing equipment abandoned by larger companies.

items.title: Irish cenbank fines Coinbase arm $3.6M for oversight, safeguard failures
items.summary: According to the Central Bank of Ireland, Coinbase Ireland had agreed with the facts around the enforcement action and will be subject to fines and sanctions upon approval.

items.title: Bitcoin circles $81.5K ETF cost basis as Trump Iran comments send stocks lower
items.summary: Bitcoin extended daily losses to 3% as US stocks came under pressure from President Donald Trump's comments on Iran military action.

items.title: Fireblocks disputes report of $2.5B Visa acquisition talks
items.summary: Fireblocks told Cointelegraph that reports of a potential $2.5 billion acquisition by Visa are not true at present time, while Visa declined to comment on the reported talks.

items.title: a16z Drops Crypto From Its Name, Widens Bets to AI and Frontier Tech
items.summary: Andreessen Horowitz is renaming its crypto fund a16z Frontier and widening its scope to AI, autonomous machines and biology, saying the line between crypto and everyday tech has blurred.

items.title: Meta Creates Non-Voting Stock to Fund AI Buildout, Keeping Zuckerberg in Control
items.summary: Meta will hand shareholders a free non-voting share for every share they own in January, giving it a way to raise equity for AI spending without diluting Zuckerberg's control.

items.title: Coinbase Fined Again in Ireland, This Time $3.6M Over Fund Safeguarding
items.summary: The Central Bank of Ireland penalized Coinbase Ireland for leaning too heavily on its U.S. parent and leaving its safeguarding account underfunded.

items.title: Tesla's Profit Drops 43% as Musk Starts Building Robots and Plans to Sell Driverless Cabs
items.summary: Tesla earned $787 million last quarter, down from $1.37 billion, as spending on robots and self-driving cars soared.

items.title: Oil Climbs Above $111 as AI Stocks Slide, Dragging the S&P 500 and Global Markets With Them
items.summary: Brent crude hit a five-month high while Nvidia, Meta and chip stocks fell, pulling Asia's benchmark indexes down.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Erase October Losses With $1 Billion in Three Days
items.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs have drawn about $1.07 billion over three sessions, pushing October flows to a gain of roughly $460 million.

items.title: JPMorgan says crypto regulatory moves partly offset Clarity Act failure, but risks remain
items.summary: JPMorgan said actions by U.S. regulators partly offset the Clarity Act setback, but longer-lasting rules are still needed.

items.title: Blockchain Association pushes for crypto tax clarity as broader bill stalls
items.summary: As progress stalls on a crypto bill, the Blockchain Association is urging Congress to pass legislation to resolve uncertainty around taxes.

items.title: Aerodrome and Velodrome merge to launch Aero across seven blockchain networks
items.summary: Aerodrome and Velodrome have merged to launch Aero across Ethereum mainnet, Base, Robinhood Chain, Ink, OP Mainnet, Arc, and Arbitrum.

items.title: Standard Chartered moves to bring crypto custody in-house as Wall Street's digital asset infrastructure race accelerates
items.summary: Custody integration would follow completion, while the software separation already outlined in May remains part of the transaction plan.

items.title: Bitcoin's $80,000 floor faces Friday inflation test as ETF inflows lose momentum
items.summary: Bitcoin holds the $80,000 area, where Glassnode places the estimated average acquisition costs of US spot Bitcoin ETFs and publicly traded corporate treasuries, while ETF inflows slowed.

items.title: Blockchain Association Presses Congress on Crypto Taxes as Clarity Act Stalls
items.summary: The Blockchain Association asked congressional leaders Thursday to pass bipartisan crypto tax legislation, but with the Clarity Act near dead.

items.title: Robinhood Wins Dubai License to Bring Bitcoin and Stock Trading to the Middle East in 2027
items.summary: Robinhood has won DFSA approval to offer bitcoin, crypto and stock trading in the Middle East starting in 2027.

items.title: Fireblocks Denies Report of $2.5 Billion Visa Takeover Talks
items.summary: Fireblocks has denied an Axios report that Visa is in late-stage talks to acquire the crypto custody firm.

items.title: A16z is the latest VC giant to widen bets beyond crypto and into AI and emerging tech
items.summary: The venture investor behind early bets on Coinbase, Solana and Uniswap said is broadening its focus, joining other crypto investment firms looking beyond blockchain to artificial intelligence and tech themes.

items.title: Irish central bank fines Coinbase Ireland $3.6 million over fund safeguarding failures
items.summary: When Silvergate was on the verge of collapse in 2023, Coinbase instructed 30 customers to deposit funds into an alternate account held by Coinbase at another U.S. bank.

items.title: Crypto custody specialist Fireblocks denies it's in talks to be acquired by Visa
items.summary: The company denied reports of talks with Visa over a potential $2.5 billion acquisition.

items.title: Ethereum's four-minute settlement plan could lower the cost of moving crypto
items.summary: A new draft targets a fourfold cut in the time it takes Ethereum transactions to become final, which could free up money transfer services.
